title: Secondary turns calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates N₂ = (U₂/U₁) × N₁ to obtain 108 turns.

title: Current ratio relationship
description: Essential: States the correct current ratio I₁/I₂ = N₂/N₁ = U₂/U₁.

title: Current ratio value
description: Essential: Provides the final simplified ratio as 9:95 or 9/95.

title: Transformer principle application
description: Important: Recognizes and applies the ideal transformer voltage-turn relationship.

title: Power conservation concept
description: Important: Implicitly or explicitly uses I₁U₁ = I₂U₂ for an ideal transformer.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout calculations or notes dimensionless ratios.

title: Inverted ratio confusion
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly states I₁/I₂ = N₁/N₂ or U₁/U₂ instead of the reciprocal.

title: Calculation error
description: Pitfall: Makes arithmetic mistakes in computing N₂ or simplifying the current ratio.
